facts.business: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Limited is an integrated maritime infrastructure company operating across dredging, shipbuilding, and chartering & hiring of port ancillary crafts with a fleet of over 45 vessels.

segments.name: Chartering & Hiring of Port Ancillary Crafts

capacity_or_capex.item: Acquisition of workshop at Taloja (capable of building up to 22-metre length boats)
Land acquisition near Saphale for proposed shipyard development in three phases
Purchase of River Pearl 1 from associate company
Purchase of River Pearl 18 (TSHD) from Knowledge Marine Co. W.L.L., Bahrain

guidance_or_targets.statement: Crossing the US$1 billion market-capitalisation milestone
Building a larger, stronger and more enduring KMEW through bigger opportunities, stronger fleet, deeper participation across maritime value chain and strategic investments

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: Claim of Rs.39.01 crores raised in FY2024-25, Rs.14.13 crores received, balance Rs.24.89 crores outstanding for over one year as on 31 March 2026. Management confident of recovery with Rs.8.60 crores received in current year.

key_risks: Recovery of outstanding claim of Rs.24.89 crores from client
Substantial Capital Work-in-Progress investments with inherent challenges in accurate recognition, measurement and disclosure
Implementation of new Labour Codes and financial impact
High interest cost in initial years of capex compared to revenue generated from underlying assets
facts.related_party_note: Purchase of River Pearl 1 from associate company M/s KMEW Offshore Private Limited for Rs 1.35 crores. Purchase of River Pearl 18 from Knowledge Marine Co. W.L.L., Bahrain for Rs. 39.19 Crores.
